title: Commitment check — the ledger beat
planted: commitment DROPPED: TCPA one-pager never sent (promised call 2)

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Rahul, quick check-in before we talk pilot. You got the SOC2 report?

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Got the SOC2, yes, forwarded it to our IT guy already. But Maya, you promised my office manager a TCPA one-pager by Friday and it never showed up. She asked me twice.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: You're right, that one's on me. It goes out today, and I'll send it directly to her so it doesn't route through you.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Please. Because the texting piece is her favorite part of this whole thing and right now she's the one selling it internally, not me.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Noted, today. And thank you for the volume report — that's what let us shape the pilot. Here's the idea: two locations, your busiest and your smallest, running live before you commit the other three.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Two locations I can defend to Dr. Mehta without a fight. Which two is my call though.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Completely your call. What's changed on your side since we talked?

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Front desk turnover, again. Lost two receptionists this month. Every new hire has to learn RingHawk's fifteen screens, and honestly training time is becoming its own cost.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: For what it's worth, new staff get one screen with us. Ring, answer, text. The pilot will show that faster than I can say it.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Good. So — TCPA paper today, pilot proposal on paper this week, and the sharper number you owe me from last time comes with it.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: All three. You'll have the proposal and the number together.
